<description>
Add `feature_taproot` spenders for script edge cases that other implementations have gotten wrong: CSV with -2, a 5-byte operand whose value fits in 1 byte, IFDUP on negative or non-minimal zero, ROLL with duplicate values, OP_16 in a P2SH scriptSig, and a P2SH scriptSig that leaves 1,000 items for the scriptPubKey to run on.

None of the current vectors catch an interpreter that gets these wrong. Merging their dumps into the script assets adds new coverage, and a regeneration of the script assets keeps them.

These were discovered by finding gaps in alternate implementations (bitcoin-s and rbitcoin)

Script assets: bitcoin-core/qa-assets#297
</description>
